source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 全国各地为何都在“爆改地铁”
topics.official_english: Why cities across China are giving their subway stations a makeover
topics.why_hot: A broad urban-life topic that touches commuters in many cities at once, so it travels well beyond local audiences.
topics.share_angle: Look at how transit upgrades affect daily commuting, accessibility and city identity — what changes riders actually notice.

topics.chinese_topic: “人造太阳”距离点亮万家灯火有多远
topics.official_english: How far is the 'artificial sun' from lighting up ordinary homes?
topics.why_hot: Fusion energy is a recurring science story with strong public curiosity about timelines and real-world impact.
topics.share_angle: Explain what fusion research has achieved so far and why the gap to commercial power remains, using cautious, source-based framing.

topics.chinese_topic: “饿死肿瘤”的方法竟然真找到了
topics.official_english: A method to 'starve tumors' reportedly found, sparking wide discussion
topics.why_hot: Cancer treatment claims spread fast online, and audiences want to know how seriously to take them.
topics.share_angle: Walk through what the headline does and does not establish, and why early research findings need cautious reading.

topics.chinese_topic: 全球跑的中国游客 让老外过上黄金周
topics.official_english: Chinese travelers abroad are boosting peak-season business for destinations worldwide
topics.why_hot: Holiday travel volume is a visible economic and cultural story, especially during the National Day break.
topics.share_angle: Discuss outbound travel trends and how host destinations adapt services, pricing and staffing.

topics.official_english: Building houses 'like cars': modular construction moves closer to reality
topics.why_hot: Combines housing, manufacturing and technology — three topics Chinese audiences follow closely.
topics.share_angle: Explain prefabricated and modular building in plain terms: what it changes for cost, speed and quality.

topics.chinese_topic: 亚运三金到手 归来仍是高中生
topics.official_english: Asian Games triple gold medalist returns to life as a high school student
topics.why_hot: Sports achievement plus a student identity makes an uplifting, widely relatable story.
topics.share_angle: Focus on balancing elite sport and schooling, and how young athletes manage both.

topics.chinese_topic: 这些涉及假期的网传信息都是假的
topics.official_english: Holiday-related viral claims circulating online are false, authorities say
topics.why_hot: Rumor debunking during peak travel season is practical public-interest information.
topics.share_angle: Give viewers a checklist for spotting holiday rumors and where to verify official notices.

topics.chinese_topic: 敦煌鸣沙山游客坐满整座山宛如拼豆
topics.official_english: Dunhuang's Mingsha Mountain packed with visitors during the holiday
topics.why_hot: Vivid visuals from a famous cultural tourism site make this an easy-to-share travel story.
topics.share_angle: Talk about holiday crowds at heritage sites and the debate over tourism capacity and preservation.
